proposals.evidence: Platts labels kam Persian and records “less, little, small, scanty”. The existing Persian kam donor node supports these Hindi few responses as loans, rather than inherited continuations of a similar Sanskrit form. Non-Hindi regional attestations are not assigned directly to Persian by this rule.
